data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at the start of 2016 were GBP 153.765m. Using the published gross claims development triangle, older underwriting years (2011-2014) show a net adverse development of c.GBP 20.06m (a strengthening of reserves, ~13.1% of opening gross claims). Narrative commentary notes a high frequency of catastrophe and large losses in 2016 (notably Hurricane Matthew and the Alberta wildfires) which impacted the property account, offset by releases on property overall; however the professional liability and certain marine cargo lines experienced reserve strengthening. The report explicitly states a net release of GBP 1.4m after reinsurance, but no gross prior-year movement is quoted, so the gross movement above was calculated from the gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: Overall worldwide property losses were US$154bn and insured losses were US$45.1bn which were above the inflation-adjusted average for the past ten years.
This experience was reflected in the property account: that incurred a higher number of catastrophe losses in 2016 than anticipated.
The largest two events were Hurricane Matthew and the Alberta wildfires but we also suffered from a number of smaller earthquake and flood claims across our global portfolio.

The catastrophe losses were compounded by a high frequency of large losses during 2016 but despite this elevated level of activity, the property account did benefit from a release of reserves during the financial year.
There has been some reserve strengthening on marine cargo business written in 2014.

The professional liability book has had continued reserve strengthening in 2016, largely related to deterioration on specific known events, the result of reviews to material contracts and claims notified using both internal and external resources.
Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 1.4m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2016. In 2015 there was a reserve strengthening of GBP 4.4m.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement figure is given in the notes or narrative. The report quotes a NET release of GBP 1.4m (net of reinsurance). A gross prior-year movement was therefore calculated from the gross claims development (triangle) on page 34; this is a last-resort calculation per instructions. The gross PYD derived from the triangle is +GBP 20.057m (strengthening). The segmental analysis shows a small negative aviation premium entry; amounts in the tables are presented in GBP '000 in the report and have been converted to millions here.
